description: Ladderback's state: each plan with its last operation, last successful backup and how long ago, whether it is overdue and its next run; the operations queued or running; the repositories that couldn't be read at their last attempt; the Full Disk Access state; this program's build and, in connect mode, the daemon's build, sign-in state and exposure.
name: status
title: Status

description: The configured plans, a page at a time: each with its repository, whether it has a schedule, its next run and its configuration warnings.

cursor.description: The `next` of the page before, to list the page after it.

limit.description:
How many to list, a whole number from 1 to 200; 50 when not given. A
larger number lists 200, and 0 lists 1.

name: list_plans
title: List plans

description: The configured repositories, a page at a time: each with its location, credentials masked, where its password comes from, whether it is maintained here and its configuration warnings. Never a secret.

cursor.description: The `next` of the page before, to list the page after it.

limit.description:
How many to list, a whole number from 1 to 200; 50 when not given. A
larger number lists 200, and 0 lists 1.

name: list_repositories
title: List repositories

description: One repository's snapshots, newest first, a page at a time, read from the repository; only those of a plan, or taken on a host, when either is named.

cursor.description:
The `next` of the page before, asked with the same filters, to list
the page after it.

host.description:
Only the snapshots taken on this host, by its name exactly as the
snapshots give it.

limit.description:
How many to list, a whole number from 1 to 200; 50 when not given. A
larger number lists 200, and 0 lists 1.

plan.description:
Only the snapshots of this plan, by its ID: those whose
`ladderback-plan:` tag names it.

repository.description: The repository, by its alias, as `list_repositories` names it.

name: list_snapshots
title: List snapshots

description: One folder of a snapshot, a page at a time, read from the repository: each entry's name, whether it is a folder, a file, a link or something else, a file's size and when it was last modified, with how many entries the folder holds. Restoring and downloading are done by the person, in the web UI.

from.description: The `next` of the page before, to list the page after it.

limit.description:
How many entries to list, a whole number from 1 to 200; 50 when not
given. A larger number lists 200, and 0 lists 1.

path.description:
The folder, by the names of the folders that lead to it from the
snapshot's top, joined by `/` (each a `name` a listing gave); the
snapshot's top when not given.

repository.description: The repository, by its alias, as `list_repositories` names it.

snapshot.description: The snapshot, by its full ID, as `list_snapshots` gives it.

name: list_snapshot_folder
title: List snapshot folder

description: Finds files and folders by name across a repository's newest snapshots, or one plan's: each match's path, and the snapshots that hold it with its size and when it was last modified there. Searches at most 100 snapshots for at most 15 seconds, returns at most 500 matches, and says which cap cut it short. Restoring and downloading are done by the person, in the web UI.

matches.description:
How many matches to return, a whole number from 1 to 500; 100 when
not given. A larger number returns 500, and 0 one.

plan.description:
Only the snapshots of this plan, by its ID: those whose
`ladderback-plan:` tag names it.

repository.description: The repository, by its alias, as `list_repositories` names it.

snapshots.description:
How many of the newest snapshots to search, a whole number from 1 to
100; 20 when not given. A larger number searches 100, and 0 one.

name: find_in_snapshots
title: Find in snapshots

description: The history of operations, newest first, a page at a time, running ones included: each with its status, times, warning codes and, when it failed, why.

cursor.description: The `next` of the page before, to list the page after it.

limit.description:
How many to list, a whole number from 1 to 200; 50 when not given. A
larger number lists 200, and 0 lists 1.

plan.description: Only this plan's operations, by its ID.

name: list_operations
title: List operations

description: One operation: its summary, why it failed when it did, and the first 100 warnings it recorded.

operation.description: The operation's ID, as `run_plan` or `list_operations` names it.

name: get_operation
title: Get operation

description: The daemon's recent log, newest first, as the web UI's Log page shows it: of a level or worse, and of an operation, a plan or a time range when asked. At most 200 lines and 32 KiB of text a call; stopped says which cap cut the page short, and next reads on from it.

before.description: The `next` of the page before, to read the lines older than it.

level.description:
Only the lines at this level or worse, most severe first: `error`,
`warn`, `info`, `debug` or `trace`, as the Log page's "Warnings and
errors" is `warn`. Every line when not given.

limit.description:
How many lines to read, a whole number from 1 to 200; 50 when not
given. A larger number reads 200, and 0 one. An answer holds at most
32 KiB of text however many lines it is asked for.

operation.description:
Only the lines that name this operation, by its ID, as
`list_operations` gives it.

plan.description:
Only the lines that name this plan, by its ID: those saying
`plan <id>`.

since.description:
Only the lines written at this instant or later, in RFC 3339, such as
`2026-11-20T09:00:00Z` or a line's `at`.

until.description: Only the lines written at this instant or earlier, in RFC 3339.

name: read_log
title: Read log

description: Queues a backup of a plan now, under the plan's overlap policy, and returns its operation's ID. Its hooks and secret sources run as for any other run.

plan.description: The plan's ID, as `list_plans` names it.

name: run_plan
title: Run plan

description: Waits until an operation finishes or the timeout passes, then returns whether it finished and the operation as get_operation does; when its warnings are too many to read, none are listed, unlisted-warnings is absent and its warning-codes still name them. Sends progress notifications when the call asks for them. Cancelling the call stops the wait, not the operation.

operation.description: The operation's ID, as `run_plan` or `list_operations` names it.

timeout.description:
How many seconds to wait at most, a whole number from 0 to 600; 60
when not given. A larger number waits 600; 0 reads the operation once.

name: wait_operation
title: Wait for operation

description: Asks a queued or running backup to stop, however it started; it then ends as cancelled. Maintenance can't be cancelled from here.

operation.description: The backup's ID, as `run_plan` or `list_operations` names it.

name: cancel_operation
title: Cancel operation

description: Tries each location of a configured repository, as a backup would choose among them, and tells each one's outcome. Records nothing.

repository.description: The repository's alias, as `list_repositories` names it.

name: test_repository
title: Test repository

description: What a forget of a repository maintained here would let go, by each plan's retention, and what it leaves alone. Reads the repository; deletes nothing.

repository.description: The repository's alias, as `list_repositories` names it.

name: preview_forget
title: Preview forget

description: What importing a rustic profile, given as its TOML text, would add: the repository's name, the plans and what the import couldn't carry over. Saves nothing and reads no file; profiles it uses are named in a notice.

content.description:
The rustic profile's TOML itself, never a path: no file is read, and
the profiles it uses are named in a notice.

repository.description: The alias the profile's repository would be saved under.

name: preview_import
title: Preview import

description: A plan as a profile the stock rustic reads, and what the export left out. A password stored in the configuration is refused, never written out; the password command, every option rustic runs as a command and every hook are left out, each named in a notice.

plan.description: The plan's ID, as `list_plans` names it.

name: export_profile
title: Export profile

description: Proposes configuration changes for a person to approve in Ladderback's web UI: plans to add, change or remove, with the reason why. Changes nothing until a person approves; no tool approves. Returns the proposal kept, its ID and what the submission checks warn of. A plan names a repository by its alias, never a secret.

changes.description:
The changes, applied in this order when a person approves them. Each
is an object with its `kind` and either `plan` or `plan_id`, never
both: `add-plan` adds the plan after the last one and `change-plan`
puts it in place of the plan with its ID, each giving in `plan` the
plan's table as TOML text: the keys of a `[[plans]]` entry in the
configuration file, without the header (`id = "home"`, `repository`,
`sources` and so on); `remove-plan` gives in `plan_id` the ID of the
plan to remove. A plan names a repository by its alias, never a
secret. A proposal can't add a hook, and a `change-plan` must keep the
plan's hooks as they are. `get_proposal` gives the changes back as the
daemon keeps them: a plan as an object of its keys, and a removal's
ID in `plan`.

plan.description: For `add-plan` and `change-plan`: the plan's table, as TOML text.

plan_id.description: For `remove-plan`: the ID of the plan to remove.

rationale.description:
Why, in the AI agent's own words: shown apart from the summary
Ladderback writes of the changes.

name: propose_setup
title: Propose setup

description: One proposal, by its ID: its status, its changes, its rationale and the reasons a person gave for rejecting any of them. With an API token, only a proposal that token made.

proposal.description: The proposal's ID, as `propose_setup` returned it.

name: get_proposal
title: Get proposal

description: Withdraws a pending proposal, so no person approves it, and returns it. With an API token, only a proposal that token made.

proposal.description: The proposal's ID, as `propose_setup` returned it.

name: withdraw_proposal
title: Withdraw proposal

description: Counts what a draft plan would back up, without backing anything up: the files and bytes its sources hold through its source filter, and what each exclude removes on its own. Counts and sizes only, never a path. Reads only within the folders a person allowed on Ladderback's Settings page; runs no hook and opens no repository. One runs at a time, none while a backup runs or waits, each stops after a short time or a number of entries and says so, and each client may start a few an hour.

plan.description:
The draft plan's table as TOML text: the keys of a `[[plans]]` entry
in the configuration file, without the header (`id = "home"`,
`repository`, `sources` and so on), as `propose_setup` takes a plan.

name: dry_run_plan
title: Dry-run plan
